edits.old: | X8 | A role without Platform administration R lists the break rows | 403 | MSG-P4-002 | AC18 |
edits.new: | X8 | A role without Platform administration R lists the break rows | 403 | MSG-P4-002 | AC17 |

AC16: Given a view or a store returns an error during the run for a business date, When the run ends, Then no result is written for that date, the run is FAILED with the system named, and MSG-GEN-006 is shown.

AC17: Given a role without Platform administration R, When it lists the break rows of a run, Then the request is refused with 403 and MSG-P4-002.

AC18: Given an approved restructure treatment whose plan is not booked in v_ace_plan two business days after approval, Then it is a break (BR3). Given a payment in v_ace_payment with no proceeds matched to its payment_code one business day after the payment date, Then it stays on the exception list and counts as a break (BR4).
